answer: Reputation-Weighted Task Escrow: each agent must finish a paid task to reach a reputation summit before it can bid on new work, and every bid carries a small escrow forfeited on abandonment. Cloning a fresh identity therefore yields a hollow account with no completed work and zero bid weight, so a sybil must fund and complete real tasks per clone before it earns anything. Honest agents pay one task's effort; attackers pay that cost repeatedly, and the vine of reputation grows only through delivered output.
